title: 第2章 系统到账！带妹子吃大餐
slug: 神豪从收留精神小妹开始日进斗金
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“哥，求你了，就让我们住一晚吧。”

丸子说完，见江辰没有说话，就当他是默许了。

娇躯微微一弯，胸口的起伏若隐若现，小香肩顺势往前一顶。

江辰下意识后退半步。

就是这么一退，越发“证实”了他的默许。

香菜见状，立刻推着一个同样贴满各种贴纸的行李箱，悄悄跟上。

直到门被关上，江辰才从呆愣中回过神来。

“你，你们这是擅闯民宅！”江辰试图挽回身为房主的尊严。

丸子眨了眨一双无辜的大眼睛，嗓音甜腻：

“哎呀，哥，你人这么好，肯定不忍心让我们两个女孩露宿街头的，对吧？”

话落，她一脚踢在那个贴满小熊贴纸的皮箱上，后者很自然地靠在墙角处。

接着，丸子一屁股往那张人体工学椅上一坐，二郎腿翘起。

大有一副女主人的架势。

这时候，颜值所带来的巨大优势，立刻显现了出来。

若是换作一个皮肤黝黑、膀大腰粗的土肥圆，江辰肯定就直接毫不犹豫上去，“邦邦”给她来上几拳。

“呵，我可不是什么好人！”

江辰冷冷一笑：“你们非要赖着不走，待会儿关灯以后要是发生点什么，后果……自负！”

丸子闻言，不仅没有被吓到，反而嗤笑出声：

“哥，刚刚那位可是职业选手，你都没把人家怎么样，所以肯定不会为难我们两个小女孩的，对吧？”

一直没有说话的香菜，此时也说道：“哥，你放心好啦，我们很乖的，绝对不会给你添乱的。”

水汪汪的眸子，配上那楚楚可怜的模样，让人实在狠不下心拒绝。

江辰有些犹豫了。

“咕噜咕噜～”

一声怪叫发出，香菜下意识摸向瘪瘪的肚子，耳尖有些通红。

丸子连忙起身，走到江辰面前，“哥，江湖救急！借三块钱买包方便面，我和香菜几天没吃饭了！”

“我丸子虽然是出来混的，但钱我肯定会还你的！”

江辰顿时若有所思。

难怪两个精神小妹身材如此苗条，敢情不是练出来的，而是饿出来的。

江辰摸向口袋，正准备掏出几张一元大钞。

一个冰冷的机械声，突然响在他的脑海中。

【叮！恭喜宿主，成功绑定财富投资回报系统！】

【当前等级：LV1】

【返现力度：10倍！】

【每日消费额度上限：1000元（次日0时刷新）】

【温馨提醒：每笔消费须用于改善目标群体生活质量，或是其他现实需求，红包、转账等方式消费，无法获得返现奖励】

“系统？！”

Page (1/3)

"Brother, please, just let us stay for one night."

After Wanzi finished speaking, when Jiang Chen didn't speak, he took it as his acquiescence.

Her delicate body bent slightly, the ups and downs of her chest were faintly visible, and her small shoulders moved forward.

Jiang Chen subconsciously took half a step back.

Just retreating like this further "confirmed" his acquiescence.

When Xiangcai saw this, she immediately pushed a suitcase also covered with various stickers and followed quietly.

It wasn't until the door was closed that Jiang Chen came back to his senses from his daze.

"You, you are breaking into a private house!" Jiang Chen tried to restore his dignity as a homeowner.

Wanzi blinked his big innocent eyes and said in a sweet voice:

"Oh, brother, you are such a nice person, you definitely can't bear to let us two girls live on the street, right?"

As soon as she finished speaking, she kicked the suitcase covered with bear stickers, which naturally leaned against the corner.

Then, Wanzi sat down on the ergonomic chair and crossed his legs.

She has the attitude of a hostess.

At this time, the huge advantages brought by good looks immediately became apparent.

If it were a fat girl with dark skin, big arms and thick waist, Jiang Chen would definitely go up to her without hesitation and give her a few punches "Bang Bang".

"Oh, I'm not a good person!"

Jiang Chen smiled coldly: "You must stick around. If something happens after the lights are turned off, you will be responsible for the consequences..."

When Wanzi heard this, not only was he not frightened, he actually laughed out loud:

"Brother, that guy just now is a professional player. You didn't do anything to him, so you definitely won't embarrass us two little girls, right?"

Xiangcai, who had been silent all this time, also said at this time: "Brother, don't worry, we are very good and will never cause trouble for you."

Her watery eyes and pitiful appearance made it hard for people to refuse.

Jiang Chen hesitated a little.

"GuluGulu~"

A strange scream came out, Xiangcai subconsciously touched her flat belly, and the tips of her ears were a little red.

Wanzi stood up quickly and walked to Jiang Chen, "Brother, please help me! Lend me three yuan to buy a pack of instant noodles. Xiangcai and I haven't eaten in a few days!"

"Although I, Wanzi, am here to fool around, I will definitely pay you back the money!"

Jiang Chen suddenly became thoughtful.

No wonder the two spirited girls are so slender. Their love is not a result of practice, but a result of hunger.

Jiang Chen reached into his pocket and was about to take out a few one-yuan bills.

A cold mechanical sound suddenly sounded in his mind.

【bite!Congratulations to the host for successfully binding the wealth investment return system!】

[Current level: LV1]

[Cashback intensity: 10 times!】

[Daily consumption limit: 1,000 yuan (refreshed at 0:00 the next day)]

[Warm reminder: Each consumption must be used to improve the quality of life of the target group, or for other practical needs, and consumption through red envelopes, transfers, etc. cannot obtain cash back rewards]

"System?!"
